title: Add a test target to the Makefile
intent: Ensure the repository Makefile exposes a `test` target that runs the project's test suite, creating the Makefile if it does not yet exist.

preconditions.description: shell tool available in the run sandbox

steps.intent: Create Makefile with a test target if missing.

inputs.command: if [ ! -f Makefile ] || ! grep -q '^check:' Makefile; then printf 'check:\n\tpytest -q\n' >> Makefile; fi

failure_modes.symptom: marker file missing or incomplete after write
failure_modes.response: re-run the write step; do not promote on partial marks
